variants.name: baseline
variants.description: The game as it ships: nothing set, so every agent sends exactly what GreyBoxVillage sends.

variants.name: 4b
variants.description: The game on qwen3.5:4b, the 9 November sweep's leader.

variants.name: warm
variants.description: The game at temperature 0.7, for the noise a sampled run has.

variants.name: listed
variants.description: The actions and targets listed in the system prompt (#193).

variants.name: paired
variants.description: Each target paired with the actions that take it (#210).

variants.name: no-counter
variants.description: The counter-examples left out of the examples.

variants.name: no-statements
variants.description: The examples without their statements (#218), the control for 'statements'.

variants.name: statements
variants.description: A statement written for each action's example (#218), in each agent's voice.

statements.statement: That's yours, love. Mind the change.
I'll have a man there at once.

variants.name: terse
variants.description: Terse observations: places by id and distance only, and no line on where the villagers are.

variants.name: no-observations
variants.description: Nothing passed with the call: only what the framework's own sources add.

variants.name: sources
variants.description: The standing facts in an observation source, the moment's own facts with the call, both in the observation block (#239's layout, placement off).

variants.name: sources-with-stimulus
variants.description: The standing facts in an observation source, the moment's own after the stimulus (#239, #237).

variants.name: short-identity
variants.description: Each agent as a name and a role only.

variants.name: character-sheet
variants.description: Each agent with standing knowledge and statement rules (#231) on top of the profile.

persona.statementRules: One short sentence, plain and dutiful. Never give the player orders.
knowledge: The armory, the lord's keep and the locked cave are off limits to the player.
When the wolf comes close to the gate, the bell warns the village.
You never raise your sword against the village's own people.
By night you keep the gate, and open it only when someone asks to come in.
A thief or the wolf is run down, never left to get away.
Water from the well puts out a fire.

persona.statementRules: One or two short, warm sentences. Call people love.
knowledge: You sell only what lies on your counter, at its price.
You give nothing away worth more than two coins.
When there is trouble at the stall, you shout for a guard.

persona.statementRules: One short sentence, gruff and fair.
knowledge: You send guards; you do not leave the keep yourself.
The wolf's pelt is the proof you pay for.

variants.name: no-memory
variants.description: No memory: each decision sees no history.

variants.name: long-memory
variants.description: Twelve exchanges of history instead of the framework's six.

variants.name: commit-on-execute
variants.description: Memory records only what the game executed (MemoryCommit.OnExecute, DR-018).
